text:
nora: opened PR #4915 to add a "parser fallbacks" section for action-envelope docs. includes small py/js snippets and a short regression prompt set. PTAL @dan @mia. preview: https://deploy-preview.example.com/4915

dan: looked it over. please relax the schema example so `args` is optional and show a tolerant parse path for malformed JSON. also add a note about logging both attempts (strict parse then fallback).

mia: QA wants explicit tiny prompts (5) to test envelope, missing action, malformed-json, freeform, and header-based action. I'll add them.

joel: quick nit: snippets reference old sdk names. i'll send a tiny PR to update to action_call/actionCall.

sam: deploy preview failed: 404 on /static/snippets/parser-fallback.js (case mismatch). pinging eng-frontend.

nora: added regex-based fallback example and the logging recommendation. linked Mia's prompt PR. removed strict enforcement of metadata.request_id (recommend only).

dan: LGTM on wording. can we recommend confidence >= 0.6 before auto-execute and require human-review flag for destructive ops?

mia: pushed prompt set in #4916.

joel: pushed snippet name fixes in #4917.

sam: fixed static path capitalization. re-run preview -> build green.

docs-bot: PR #4915 checks passed. 0 unresolved comments. ready to merge.
